newsitem.title: USA: D&P places Leucadia National on watch.
newsitem.headline: D&P places Leucadia National on watch.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said it has placed the debt ratings of Leucadia National Corp on rating watch/developing after announcement of Leucadia's agreement to sell its subsidiaries, Colonial Penn Life Insurance Co and Providential Life Insurance Co and certain assets to Conseco Inc for $460 million.
The debt on watch includes senior debt rated at triple-B-minus; senior subordinated debt rated at triple-B-minus; and convertible subordinated debt rated at double-B-plus.
The rating watch affects about $526 million in debt securities, and the sale is expected to result in a pretax gain of $300 million.
The ratings reflect the sound operating fundamentals and balance-sheet strength of Leucadia and its wholly owned operating subsidiaries, the credit rating company said in a statement.
D&P said its further due diligence will focus on the expected impact on Leucadia's capital structure and cash flow and Leucadia's use of the proceeds.
Leucadia has total assets of $5.2 billion and offers property/casualty insurance, life insurance, banking and lending services.
